svg.title: Our goal — a persistent world that evolves beyond the view
svg.desc: Conceptual target capabilities, not model results. Three moments in one world. First a player places an orange block. The player explores a new area while water continues flowing outside the camera view. On returning, the tree and placed block remain and water has spread into the lower basin. Solid geometry is shared across the sequence; only water, player position, and newly explored terrain change.
